about: Reconciliation of supabase/migrations (repository) with supabase_migrations.schema_migrations (production history), established 2026-11-05 by read-only comparison. history_version=null means: applied in production by hand (SQL editor), never recorded in the history table. Never re-apply, never rewrite the history; this file only documents it. Checked by test/backup-migrations.test.js and on every backup run.

verified.method: production catalog (read-only) vs. a throwaway build of supabase/schema.sql + every repository migration: 230 columns identical, 82 constraints identical, 6 policies identical, 12 functions identical up to whitespace (finalize_outreach_daily_slot, reopen_quote_with_quota, safe_import_qualified_prospect), indexes identical except one (see 003_release.sql)

files.note: the repository file also creates index prospects_email_plain_unique, which production does not have (uniqueness is already enforced by constraint prospects_email_key); the backup carries the DEPLOYED schema
recorded in production under a different timestamp than the repository file name

files.evidence: followups.business_date, followups.channel, functions confirm_manual_followup / finalize_relanzio_followup present in production
tables outreach_candidates, sales_followups and functions claim_outreach_daily_slot / apply_outreach_reply present in production
table followup_optouts, profiles.followup_offsets, function followup_gap_days present in production
table digest_sends, profiles.morning_digest_enabled present in production
table quote_replies, function apply_quote_reply present in production
